title: Introduce semantically-aware mini-batch sentinel and deadline gate for CI evals
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Prompt-set regressions can be noisy when bulked into large minibatches during CI runs. Small semantic shifts concentrated in a subset of samples are often drowned by aggregate metrics, causing flaky pass/fail behavior and expensive reruns. This PR introduces a semantically-aware "mini-batch sentinel" that runs lightweight clustering and diversity checks inside CI eval workers, plus a deadline gate that enforces upper bounds on per-eval wall time and triggers deterministic soft-fail behavior when budgets are exceeded.

Summary:
- Add a sentinel that tracks semantic dispersion and per-cohort drift within minibatches, raising structured signals when a minibatch is anomalous.
- Integrate a deadline gate for CI eval workflows: if an eval shard exceeds N seconds, the gate will mark the run as soft-failed and output a small repro artifact and provenance hash for quick triage.
- Export new metrics for the Console: minibatch_sem_dispersion, minibatch_anomaly_count, eval_deadline_skipped_shards.
- Add a CI hook that can throttle aggressive prober runs and optionally re-route noisy shards to a conservative baseline model.
- Add unit and integration tests, docs, and an example prompt-set demonstrating sentinel-driven patch rollbacks.

Checklist:
- [x] Core sentinel logic and clustering heuristics implemented
- [x] Deadline gate implemented and wired into CI workflow
- [x] Unit tests and deterministic samplers added
- [x] E2E integration test that simulates a noisy minibatch
- [x] Docs and usage notes (docs/gates.md)
- [x] Metrics emissions and small Console dashboard example

Notes: The sentinel is intentionally lightweight (TF-IDF + locality-sensitive hashing for speed) and uses configurable thresholds so teams can tune sensitivity per-prompt-set. The deadline gate is conservative by default and configured to soft-fail (record and continue) so we don't block rollouts unnecessarily.

Related: builds on ideas from ENG-2910 (sem-cohort anchors) and complements the existing replay and rollback hooks by providing early-warning signals at the shard level.

Usage: Enable the hook in eval CI by adding the step `mini-batch-sentinel-check` to the eval workflow and set `SENTINEL_MODE=detect|enforce` and `SENTINEL_THRESHOLD` in pipeline parameters.

review_thread: Marcus Chen (review): Overall direction is good. Please make sure the LSH fallback is deterministic in CI — we need reproducible failure artifacts for reruns.
Asha Patel (author): Addressed with a deterministic seed and a small shim (see commit o6p7q8). Added an integration test that asserts stable hashing across seeds.
Zoe Kramer (review): Can we avoid TF-IDF at very large prompt vocab sizes? Might be expensive on dedicated runners. Suggest adding a truncation/feature-sample cap.
Asha Patel (author): Added a sample cap and a configurable feature-max parameter with conservative defaults; documented in docs/gates.md.
Luis Ortega (approval): Tests look good. One nits about logging verbosity — reduce INFO churn for normal runs.
Asha Patel (author): Reduced logs and added a DEBUG flag for local dev diagnostics.
release_notes: Add: semantically-aware mini-batch sentinel for CI evals; Add: deadline gate to soft-fail long-running eval shards; Add: metrics for minibatch dispersion and anomalous shard counts; Docs: gates.md describing configuration and tuning guidance.
notes_for_release: This is safe for backport to the 1.x eval runner branch. The sentinel is off by default; enabling is opt-in via CI config. Recommend opt-in on canary pipelines first.
qa_notes: QA run simulated noisy shards with 3 synthetic prompt-sets. Observed correct production of provenance hash and conservative soft-fail behavior. No regressions to baseline metrics observed when sentinel is off.
examples_and_howto: Add step to ci/workflows/eval_ci.yml: - name: mini-batch-sentinel-check uses: ./.github/actions/mini-batch-sentinel with env: SENTINEL_MODE=detect SENTINEL_THRESHOLD=0.65
Example prompt set: examples/prompt_sets/mini_batch_noisy.yaml shows a seed that triggers sentinel and emits artifact to /artifacts/minibatch-<hash>.json
